name: Electric String Pianos
description: Electric string piano listing copy — Yamaha CP-70/CP-80 series (including B, D, and MIDI-equipped M revisions) and the Helpinstill Roadmaster — per the Electric String Pianos service page. Yamaha facts sourced from Wikipedia; Helpinstill facts sourced from CEPCo's own workshop blog posts (including a direct quote from co-founder Max Brink on treating every Roadmaster as a one-off build). Anything not confidently verifiable was left out rather than guessed.

children.label: Yamaha CP-70
children.copy:
Every Yamaha CP we restore for sale receives the same detail-oriented process we bring to every instrument in our shop, with dozens of hours spent bringing it to exceptional playing and touring condition. Because the CP is a true acoustic piano at its core — hammers striking real strings, no synthesis involved — our restoration covers full piano tuning and regulation in addition to the electronics, pickups, and hardware that make it stage-ready. We use period-correct parts wherever we can, and the best available reproduction parts where we can't, always working to keep the CP's unmistakable bright, percussive character intact.

Introduced in 1976, the CP-70 was Yamaha's answer to a problem no electric piano had fully solved: how to get a real acoustic piano sound on the road. It's built around a genuine piano action — wooden keys striking hammers against real strings — but drops the soundboard in favor of piezo pickups mounted directly to the harp, giving it an accurate acoustic voice with far less risk of feedback than earlier electric pianos. The 73-key harp and key assembly split apart and fold down for transport, with the legs storing inside the lid.

Features:
- Full Piano Tuning & Regulation
- Restored Piano Action (Hammers, Dampers & Key Bed)
- Cleaned & Aligned Piezo Pickup System
- New Electrolytic Capacitors
- Fully Restored Power Supply
- CEPCo's Expert Tuning & Voicing Setup
- Cleaned All Controls & Connectors
- All Voltages Checked & Calibrated for Optimum Performance
- New Cables

Included:
- Folding Legs
- Sustain Pedal

children.label: Helpinstill Roadmaster 64
children.copy:
Every Helpinstill Roadmaster we restore for sale receives the same detail-oriented process we bring to every instrument in our shop, with dozens of hours spent bringing it to exceptional playing and touring condition. Roadmasters are true acoustic pianos at heart — a real soundboard, real strings, and a genuine piano action — fitted with Charles Helpinstill's custom electromagnetic pickup system and built into a folding, road-ready case. Because these were essentially hand-built rather than mass-produced, we treat every Roadmaster as a one-off restoration, evaluating and regulating its action, pickups, and hardware individually rather than working from a single fixed spec.

This is the 64-key Roadmaster, the more compact of the two Roadmaster sizes. Like all Roadmasters, it's a genuine acoustic piano — built by Kimball to Charles Helpinstill's specifications around his custom electromagnetic pickup design — with a folding key bed and action that collapses into its road case on casters for load-in and load-out. Some 64-key units left the factory (or were later modified) with tacks installed on the hammer tips for a brighter, more honky-tonk attack through the pickup.

Features:
- Full Piano Tuning & Regulation (A440)
- Restored Piano Action (Hammers, Dampers & Key Bed)
- Pickup Alignment & Electronics Overhaul
- New Potentiometers Where Needed
- Fully Restored Power Supply/Breakout Box Electronics
- CEPCo's Expert Tuning & Voicing Setup
- Cleaned All Controls & Connectors
- New Cables

Included:
- Road Case with Casters

children.label: Helpinstill Roadmaster 88
children.copy:
Every Helpinstill Roadmaster we restore for sale receives the same detail-oriented process we bring to every instrument in our shop, with dozens of hours spent bringing it to exceptional playing and touring condition. Roadmasters are true acoustic pianos at heart — a real soundboard, real strings, and a genuine piano action — fitted with Charles Helpinstill's custom electromagnetic pickup system and built into a folding, road-ready case. Because these were essentially hand-built rather than mass-produced, we treat every Roadmaster as a one-off restoration, evaluating and regulating its action, pickups, and hardware individually rather than working from a single fixed spec.

This is the full 88-key Roadmaster, built around the same genuine acoustic soundboard, strings, and action as the 64-key model, with the complete range of a standard piano. It's a serious piece of gear at over 200 lbs, but the key bed and action still fold directly into the road case on casters for transport. Later units typically feature three large humbucking pickups (bass, midrange, and treble) feeding into Helpinstill's own "Piano Sensor" breakout box, which provides individual pickup volume control, a master volume, tone shaping, and both XLR and 1/4" direct outputs.
